text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we're all done with the shopping. 
Let's head back to the academy soon...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Lunchtime is always bustling. The 
"Hokkaido Antenna Shop" is packed too—

text_block_list.name: Young Customers
text_block_list.text:
"—There's so much to choose from, it's 
hard to decide~. —I wonder what the locals 
usually eat?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(This could be my chance to shine...! 
Alright...!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, how about some local 
specialties from my hometown, Tomakomai?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thick and juicy surf clams! Delicious and 
nutritious haskap berries! Tomakomai is 
just full of things I want to recommend!

text_block_list.name: Other Customers
text_block_list.text:
“—Excuse me, could you teach me too? —Do 
you have anything suitable for seniors?”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'd be happy to explain!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(I have training after this, but... If I 
can wrap things up early, it should be 
fine!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, her PR was so well received that 
she couldn't easily wrap things up... and 
ended up blowing off her training.
